title: Schools Reopened, but Math Scores Still Fell to 270
hook: Schools reopened, but math scores still fell to 270.
closing: Reopening classrooms was not enough; the students furthest behind need targeted recovery.
question: Did your math skills bounce back?

segments.say: Math scores fell to 271, nearly erasing decades of gains instead of rebounding with reopened schools.
The weakest students lost 14 points, widening the gap rather than sharing the decline evenly.
Math scores slipped again to 270, showing reopening alone did not restore lost learning.
